units.source_text: 从这里看不见金阁的形状。

en.t: From here, the shape of the Golden Pavilion could not be seen.

units.source_text: 只见滚滚的浓烟和冲天的焰火。

en.t: Only billowing thick smoke and flames shooting into the sky could be seen.

units.source_text: 树丛间飞舞着无数的火星，金阁上空就像撒满了金沙。

en.t: Countless sparks danced among the trees, and the sky above the Golden Pavilion looked as though it had been sprinkled with gold dust.
